_note: Weapon stickers (2026-11-06). Up to three per gun, placed with a click on the gun in the Gunsmith, sized 0.5x-2x and turned. Entry: id, name, image (PNG with alpha, relative to this folder, any size: drawn into a 232 px atlas cell), optional unlock (a shop key; locked until owned), pass (the season, shown as MELON PASS while locked), soon (not out yet; localStorage kino.dev.soon=1 lifts it). No unlock = free for everyone.
